name: @tellma/core-ui
description: Tellma UI component library — tm-* form controls built on @angular/cdk + @angular/aria, signal-first, Signal Forms native.

Raised from 5 to 8. About 1.1 KB is the foundation seams the app shell builds on: TmBreakpoints over five media query lists, TmTheme with its System tracking, the live root Directionality, the translations loader and the touch-size resolver. About 1.4 KB is the ICU MessageFormat interpreter that replaced the eval-based compiler, so messages format under a script-src 'self' Content Security Policy with no 'unsafe-eval'; the old compiler lived in an external @jsverse package outside this measurement, so the app bundle itself shrinks (it no longer carries @messageformat/core and its plural data). The remaining headroom is for the l10n facade's planned instant and time-zone additions.
budgetNotes../popover: Raised from 4 to 4.5 for keeping open popovers inside the viewport: the width cap is written from the visible viewport width (100vw counted a classic scrollbar, so a clamped panel ran under it), and the height cap, width cap and inline offset are re-fitted on every scroll and resize while open (the CDK reports a placement only when its side changes). Measured 4087 B before these fixes and 4228 B after (+141 B net); the saving taken in the same change was folding the three fixed-size width rules into one custom property read by the base rule. The entry point holds the fixed sizes, the viewport fitting and the block cap.
budgetNotes../entity-picker: Raised from 11 to 12 for the in-field invalid glyph the picker now draws itself (the field can only append its own AFTER the whole control, which would shove the magnifier sideways every time an error came and went). Previously raised from 10 to 11. The picker measures ~10.5 KB as one eager surface: it is an editable combobox that also carries an async search lifecycle, a text/value resolution channel, three modal pages, and a grid cell-editor implementation. The remaining lever is deferring the popup into its own chunk (the date-picker's shape), which is a change to the mounting sequence this control's overlay placement and highlight protocol are sensitive to — not worth reopening for 0.5 KB. Revisit if the popup is extracted for other reasons.
budgetNotes../form-field: Re-measured after the invalid mark moved onto tm-icon: 4.71 before, 4.82 after, under the unchanged 5 (the closest of the three glyph entry points to its ceiling). Previously raised from 4 to 5 for the validation popover: the field now anchors an overlay (the shared @tellma/core-ui/overlay helper plus a CdkConnectedOverlay in its template) instead of writing a message into a row. The weight is the overlay wiring, not the bubble — the bubble itself is one presentational component shared with the grid.
budgetNotes../select: Raised from 8 to 9 for tm-multi-select and option groups: measured 6.07 before and 8.28 after. The multi-select adds its own template, the joined-label trigger and its option-order commit (about 1.4); option groups add the grouped panel markup in both templates and tm-option-group itself (about 0.5); the glyphs now draw through tm-icon with Lucide data, whose component lives in ./icon and is measured there. The saving taken was moving everything both selects share (the form-control plumbing, the value bridge, closed-trigger typeahead, the panel wiring) into one base class instead of a second copy, and sharing one stylesheet for the select chrome.
budgetNotes../checkbox: Re-measured after its check and dash moved onto tm-icon: 3.06 before, 3.24 after, under the unchanged 4. The growth is the tm-icon import's component metadata and the two Lucide paths; the inline SVG it replaces was smaller as markup but drew a second, separately maintained copy of the glyph rules.
budgetNotes../icon: Raised from 2 to 3 at birth: measured 2.7. The spec's 2 was an estimate below the real logic: the registry and the icon-data guard (the allowed elements, the refused event-handler and link attributes, attribute-name and kebab-case name checks, and refusal messages that are the only diagnostic a developer gets), plus the draw path (the template cache, the clone, the unknown-name and refusal reporting). The component's duplicated decorator metadata costs about 0.1 of it. Nothing here grows with the number of icons: icon data is its importer's weight.
budgetNotes../kbd: Raised from 1 to 2.5 at birth: measured 2.4. The spec's 1 was an estimate below the real logic: about 1.6 is the key-combination parser (with its two grammar errors), the matcher (the US punctuation table, the three event.code fallbacks, the AltGr rule) and the three label writers, and about 0.75 is tm-kbd itself, of which the duplicated decorator metadata is about 0.1.
budgetNotes../menu: Raised from 6 to 8.5 for the rich entry kinds: measured 8.4, up from 4.4. The planned ceiling was 7; that estimate sat below the real surface. Of the 4.0 added, about 1.9 is the row renderer (three row shapes: link, submenu parent, item; groups; the icon forms, second line, detail, key caps and glyphs; the link and keep-open activation rules; the development diagnostics), about 0.4 the submenu overlay, about 0.4 the menu-button trigger, about 0.3 the stylesheet, about 0.2 the dismissal and key-timing rules (the release of the right-click that opened the menu, held keys, keys pressed between an open and its render), and the rest the header block, focus on open and the trigger registration in tm-menu itself. Templates ship as source text in the measured build, so the three row shapes cost their markup, not compiled code. The three Lucide glyphs (check, chevron, external link) are 0.2 KB raw. Savings taken: a trimming pass took the first measurement down by 0.14 (8.35 to 8.21, before the 0.2 of dismissal and key-timing rules): the new-tab note moved into the row's accessible name, which dropped a visually hidden element and its style rule; the description ids are minted once per row instead of in the markup; one helper types the shared row template's context in place of repeated casts; the group rule left the stylesheet; the development messages were shortened. The submenu's own Escape registration was then folded into the menu's. Options measured and not taken, none of which reaches 7: leaving the three glyphs outside the entry point gives 8.14; stripping the development diagnostics gives 8.27; moving the trigger to an entry point of its own saves about 0.4. Each drops or relocates something this entry point is specified to hold.
budgetNotes../grid: Raised from 37 to 38 for the shared validation bubble (the cell error now renders the same component the form field does, so a cell error and a field error cannot drift apart). Previously raised from 36 to 37 for the typed-commit search rung (the editor's own search decides a commit before the column's label resolver is asked). NOTE the standing gap: spec 0004 set grid at 24 KB and the measured surface has never been near it — this ceiling has climbed 34 -> 35 -> 36 -> 37 across three specs, each time as a ratchet over measured reality. Worth a dedicated pass rather than another increment.
budgetNotes._: Ceilings are ratchets. Any raise belongs here with its reason; a raise with no note is a bug.
